columns.name: ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Actual completion date of goal.

columns.description: Goal creation context.

columns.name: GOAL_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of assignment. Possible values are Admin, HR, Manager and Worker.

columns.name: REFERENCE_CONTENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRT_CONTENT_ITEMS_B, which holds the ID of a goal in library. It represents the source of this goal record.

columns.name: REFERENCE_GOAL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRT_CONTENT_ITEMS_B, which holds the ID of a goal in library. It represents the source of the goal.

columns.name: PRIVATE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this goal is accessible to others or not

columns.name: HRCHY_ACCESS_GRANT_DATE

columns.name: ALLOW_KEY_ATTR_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Key attribute modification is allowed or not.

columns.description: Manager can delete worker goal or not.

columns.description: Goal is marked to include in performance document.

columns.description: URL related to the goal.

columns.description: Meaning of Level.

columns.description: Admin-defined category for a goal.

columns.description: Code for the measurement type

columns.description: For qualitative vs. quantitative measures. Target you are trying to hit.

columns.name: MEASURE_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments for measurement of a goal

columns.name: TARGET_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the target for the quantitative measures.

columns.name: TARGET_TYPE
columns.description: Type of target for the quantitative measures

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Units of measure, %, dollar amounts, etc

columns.name: ACTUAL_VALUE
columns.description: Actual value attained for the quantitative measures

columns.name: GOAL_EXT_ID
columns.description: Not unique at worker level

columns.description: Propagate the read-only status from goal plan. If the goal is part of two contradicting goal plans (Yes wins always - among the read-only or updatable goal plans

columns.name: GOAL_SUB_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Goal Sub Type Code is to support customer specific requirements like extensibility.

columns.name: MEASURE_CALC_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Aggregated function for aggregating the actual and target values at sub-goal (only AVG or SUM). Looup HRG_CALCULATION_RULE_CODE will list the values.
